However, it suffers from severe structural hallucinations typical of AI generation: multiple violins lack strings entirely or have strings that fade into nothingness; tailpieces appear as floating black shards unconnected to the body; chin rests are malformed or detached blobs; and neck-to-body junctions show melting/fusion artifacts. These anatomical failures significantly reduce authenticity despite the clean surface texture. The perceptual quality auditor correctly identified no graphics-level distortions (noise, blur, compression), but this does not compensate for the critical structural defects that undermine physical plausibility.
